lines.text: You don't have to fix this right now.
Let's just get through the next little while, gently.
Breathing comes first. Everything else can wait.

talkLine: People who can listen, any time, for where you are.
dangerLine: If you're thinking about hurting yourself, or you're not safe, please reach out now. Call your local emergency number, or one of the lines below.
checkInLater: Check in with me in an hour
